Lurianna Sauvage is a deceased werewolf in Szarr's Palace in Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Lurianna Sauvage is in a hidden room in the chamberlain suites in Szarr Palace. According to a note on her body, she discovered  Antwun Dufay's body along with an acid bottle. He had intended to fake his own death, but apparently, he drank the wrong bottle. Because they had planned to go together, she immediately decided to drink one of the other acid bottles to join him in the afterlife.
